claim: The pilot is approved. Minor improvements will be included in the follow-up plan without blocking closure.
evidence: There were 386 queries and 74 guided-processing cases. No service interruptions occurred.
Availability was 99.96 percent. The 95th percentile remained at 1.8 seconds, and the maximum recorded was 3.4 during a scheduled import.
Functional coverage was 100 percent for all 62 procedures. Three queries were unresolved because local expressions were missing from the synonym catalogue.
Every access, response and version was recorded. No divergence was detected between pilot data and the approved copy.
No. There were two minor training issues and one suggestion to export a procedure record as PDF.
The criteria were at least 95 percent coverage, zero critical errors and response below two seconds for the agreed queries. All three are met.
Santa Marina accepts the system and recommends moving to controlled operation for three months.
